"Sir Trygve, were there any letters sent to me?" *I asked while sipping carefully of the hot tea.*

*He answers with a deep bow* "There was one, madam. It is in your room. Would you like me to bring it to you?"

"Yes, that would be nice of you to do that", *I smiled as I watched you get the letter*

*He walks away and returns with a sealed envelope* “I believe this is the letter you are looking for madam” *He hands the envelope to you* “Anything else you require?”

"That would be all, thank you" *I answered*

*He bows respectfully for one last time and says* “I will be at your service. Please call me when you require me.” *He walks away with a calm and respectful demeanour*
